comment: This module was not built for the census, because constructing its widget outside a patch faults in PointList::addPointsToScreen, so its control positions could not be measured and nothing here was checked against a running module. Everything below comes from src/Boxes.cpp at commit 9307696 and from the rendered panel. Eight of the fifteen parameters are given widgets in BoxesWidget (delay, width, height, feedback, the two filters, diffuse and pull) and are tagged here; the six position parameters for the emitter and the two listeners are driven by the XYScreen display rather than by parameter widgets, so no click reaches them, and ALLPASS_BUTTON is configured at src/Boxes.cpp:75 but is given no widget and is never read in process, so it gets nothing. All seven inputs and all three outputs are given widgets. The panel prints DELAY, WIDTH, HEIGHT, FEEDBACK, HP, LP, DIFFUSE, PULL, SEND, RECIEVE, INPUT, A OUT and B OUT, with the control voltage jack for delay, width, height, feedback and diffuse sitting to the left of the knob it belongs to. The delay control voltage is subtracted from the knob rather than added (src/Boxes.cpp:225), so a rising voltage shortens the delay. Bypassing the module passes the input to both outputs.
